clean_best_overall.ranking_rule: no crash, full episode, lane changes <= policy median; sort by overtakes desc, mean speed desc

clean_fastest.ranking_rule: no crash, full episode, mean speed descending

clean_smoothest.ranking_rule: no crash, at least one overtake, lane changes ascending, overtakes descending

clean_dense_traffic.ranking_rule: no crash, full episode, vehicles_density == 1.8, overtakes descending

crash_floor_speed.ranking_rule: crash classified as (a) Floor-speed rear-end, speed at impact descending

crash_lane_change.ranking_rule: crash classified as (b) Lane-change collision, speed at impact descending

crash_blind_spot.ranking_rule: crash classified as (c) Blind-spot/other, speed at impact descending

most_lane_changes.ranking_rule: any outcome, lane changes descending (chatter example)

paired_floor_fix.ranking_rule: same seed & profile, baseline overtaker crashed (floor-speed rear-end) while extended-ladder seed 42 best survived; rank pairs by crashed speed at impact

paired_sensor_tier.ranking_rule: same seed, MOBIL front_only crashed while MOBIL full_adas survived; rank pairs by crashed speed at impact

paired_density.ranking_rule: same policy & seed, survived at default density and crashed at highest density (or vice versa); rank by crashed speed at impact

policy_best_clean.ranking_rule: clean_best_overall applied within each policy pool

policy_best_crash.ranking_rule: crash_fastest applied within each policy pool (1 entry per policy)
policy_best_crash.reason_if_fewer: Policies with 0 crashes in pool: deepset_v2_retrain_seed42
